## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Added graceful shutdown handlers with configurable signal support and timeout-based termination for improved reliability.
  * Enhanced shutdown logging and error reporting for better observability.

* **Bug Fixes**
  * Fixed race conditions during shutdown to ensure clean resource cleanup and prevent incomplete teardown.

<!-- end of auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->
## Walkthrough

The PR splits the shutdown handler implementation: `packages/core/utils/shutdown.ts` is reduced to a no-op stub returning `() => {}`, while a new `packages/core/utils/shutdown.node.ts` contains the full Node.js signal-handling logic (SIGTERM/SIGINT listeners, idle→closing→done state machine, `close()` raced against a 10 s timeout, and `exit(code)` with test-safe error swallowing). A new `ShutdownSignal` string alias replaces `NodeJS.Signals` in the shared options type. In `main-fuzz.ts`, an `activeReset` field is added so `close()` can await any in-flight `resetState` promise before tearing down the node/socket/DB. In `bin/jam/index.ts`, a memoized `closeNode` function prevents double-invocation of `node.close()` during the Import command. The E2E test's force-kill guard is corrected to check `exitCode`/`signalCode` instead of `proc.killed`.

## Estimated code review effort

🎯 4 (Complex) | ⏱️ ~45 minutes

- [FluffyLabs/typeberry#1010](https://github.com/FluffyLabs/typeberry/pull/1010): Changes `packages/jam/node/main-fuzz.ts` around the `resetState`/fjall-session teardown code path that this PR also modifies.
- [FluffyLabs/typeberry#965](https://github.com/FluffyLabs/typeberry/pull/965): Modifies `resetState` and shutdown teardown in `main-fuzz.ts`, intersecting directly with the `activeReset` synchronization introduced here.
